_comment: Tier-2 for skfem dg_methods#10, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Interior-layer advection-diffusion at 30 degrees, eps = 1/160, Pe_h = 10 / 5 / 2.5 over three refinements. Pure upwind ElementDG(ElementTriP1) rings and does NOT damp -- its excursion outside the physical range [0,1] creeps up 0.083 -> 0.090 -> 0.100; SUPG-CG P1 damps monotonically 0.041 -> 0.011 -> 0.0001, beats DG at every level, and uses a sixth of the DOFs. PARTIAL FALSIFICATION of the numbers: the DG ringing measures 8-10 percent, just under the catalog's '~10-30%' band, and it does NOT clear after ~3 refinement levels; the claim's ORDERING reproduces exactly.
